form.label: CIO — Security Operations & Technical Risk Posture
form.description: The technical foundation beneath the CEO/CFO/COO KPIs: vulnerability management, SOC alert triage, patch compliance, and MITRE ATT&CK activity. Drill down: KPI -> Business Unit -> System/Asset -> Raw Alert or Scan Record.

search.query: | inputlookup soc_alerts.csv | dedup business_unit | table business_unit | sort business_unit
| inputlookup vulnerability_scans.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND (severity="Critical" OR severity="High") AND patch_status!="Patched" | stats count as open_vulns

| inputlookup vulnerability_scans.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND (severity="Critical" OR severity="High") | stats count(eval(patch_status="Patched")) as patched count as total | eval pct=round((patched/total)*100,1) | table pct
| inputlookup soc_alerts.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats count as total_alerts
| inputlookup soc_alerts.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats count(eval(disposition="True Positive")) as tp count as total | eval pct=round((tp/total)*100,1) | table pct
| inputlookup soc_alerts.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats avg(triage_time_minutes) as avg_triage | eval avg_triage=round(avg_triage,1)

panel.title: SOC Alert Volume by Severity Over Time

search.query: | inputlookup soc_alerts.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | eval month=strftime(strptime(timestamp,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),"%Y-%m") | stats count by month, severity | sort month

panel.title: True-Positive Alerts by MITRE ATT&CK Tactic

search.query: | inputlookup soc_alerts.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND disposition="True Positive" | stats count by mitre_tactic | sort -count

panel.title: Open Vulnerabilities by Business Unit (click a bar to drill in)

search.query: | inputlookup vulnerability_scans.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND patch_status!="Patched" | stats count as open_vulns count(eval(severity="Critical" OR severity="High")) as critical_high by business_unit | sort -open_vulns

panel.title: SOC Alerts by Business Unit (click a bar to drill in)

search.query: | inputlookup soc_alerts.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats count as alerts count(eval(disposition="True Positive")) as true_positives by business_unit | sort -alerts

panel.title: Systems in "$sel_bu$" by Open Vulnerabilities (click a bar to drill into that system)

search.query: | inputlookup vulnerability_scans.csv | where business_unit="$sel_bu$" AND patch_status!="Patched" | stats count as open_vulns avg(cvss_score) as avg_cvss by system | sort -open_vulns

panel.title: Open Vulnerabilities — "$sel_bu$" $sel_sys$ (raw scan record, deepest drill)

search.query: | inputlookup vulnerability_scans.csv | where business_unit="$sel_bu$" AND (system="$sel_sys$" OR "$sel_sys$"="") AND patch_status!="Patched" | sort -cvss_score | table scan_id, date, asset, system, cve_id, cvss_score, severity, patch_status, days_open, exploit_available, asset_owner

panel.title: SOC Alerts — "$sel_bu$" $sel_sys$ (raw alert record, deepest drill)

search.query: | inputlookup soc_alerts.csv | where business_unit="$sel_bu$" AND (source_system="$sel_sys$" OR "$sel_sys$"="") | sort -timestamp | table alert_id, timestamp, severity, source_system, mitre_tactic, analyst, disposition, triage_time_minutes, status

html.p: Drill-down path: Vulnerability / SOC KPI tiles (Row 1) → Business Unit breakdown (Row 3, click a bar) → System/asset within that unit (Row 4, click a bar) → the individual CVE scan record or SOC alert (Row 5) — the ground-truth technical events that ultimately roll up into the COO's MTTD/MTTR, the CFO's fraud/spend ROI, and the CEO's enterprise risk score.
